ribbon.tool.groupTip: {label} — press and hold or right-click for the other tools of this group
pen.msg.joinEnds: Select two end points of open paths
pen.hint.anchorAdd: Click a path to add an anchor point (the curve keeps its shape) · hold Alt to delete
pen.hint.anchorDel: Click an anchor point to delete it — the curve keeps its shape as well as it can
pen.hint.anchorConvert: Click a point = corner ↔ smooth · drag from a point = new handles · drag a handle = that one alone · drag a segment = bend it
pen.hint.curvature: Each click adds a smooth point (Alt+click a corner) · click the first point to close · Enter / Esc to end · double-click a point to convert
pen.bar.title: Anchors
pen.bar.corner: Convert selected anchor points to corner
pen.bar.smooth: Convert selected anchor points to smooth
pen.bar.remove: Remove selected anchor points (the path stays whole)
pen.bar.cut: Cut path at selected anchor points
pen.bar.SLIDE.title: Edit Points
pen.SLIDE.pen.msg.joinEnds: Select two end points of an open path
